exams.name: Licensing examination approved by the board (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: An applicant who fails any part within four attempts must complete one additional year of postgraduate medical education. All parts must be completed within ten years.
exams.quote: Pass a licensing examination approved by the board covering appropriate medical subjects.

interval_years.quote: The credential to practice a profession shall be renewed biennially upon request of the credentialed person and upon documentation of continuing competency

required.quote: The appropriate board shall establish continuing competency requirements for persons seeking renewal of a credential.

hours_per_period.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

period_years.quote: at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

value: at least 3 hours biennially regarding prescribing opiates (for physicians who prescribe controlled substances), including 0.5 hours on the prescription drug monitoring program
topical_requirements.quote: shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates as defined in section 28-401. The continuing education may include, but is not limited to, education regarding prescribing and administering opiates, the risks and indicators regarding development of addiction to opiates, and emergency opiate situations. One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program

available.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact or meet the standards set by the board pursuant to section 38-126

requirements.value: Applicant must comply with the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact requirements or meet board-set standards; applicants who have not passed the specified licensing examinations but hold a valid license from another state based on a state examination approved by the board may also be issued a license.

scope_protection.quote: Every act or practice falling within the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in section 38-2024 and not specially excepted in this section shall constitute the practice of medicine and surgery and may be performed in this state only by those licensed by law to practice medicine in Nebraska.

definition_quote.value: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches; Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery; Persons holding themselves out to the public as being qualified in the diagnosis or treatment of diseases, ailments, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or injuries of human beings; Persons who suggest, recommend, or prescribe any form of treatment for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical or mental ailment of any person; Persons who maintain an office for the examination or treatment of persons afflicted with ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition of human beings; Persons who attach to their name the title of M.D., surgeon, physician, physician and surgeon, or any word or abbreviation and who indicate that they are engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, infirmity, or any physical or mental condition of human beings; and Persons who are physically located in another state but who, through the use of any medium, including an electronic medium, perform for compensation any service which constitutes the healing arts that would affect the diagnosis or treatment of an individual located in this state.
definition_quote.quote: the following classes of persons shall be deemed to be engaged in the practice of medicine and surgery

value: recommending or prescribing any form of treatment
methods_authorized.quote: Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe and furnish medicine; prescribing controlled substances to oneself or certain family members is prohibited as unprofessional conduct; physicians who prescribe controlled substances must complete CE on opioid prescribing.

license_status_types.quote: Temporary educational permit means a permit to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or any of their allied specialties in graduate medical education, a fellowship, or a refresher course.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) that is currently effective, or provide credentials certifying successful passage of the Visa Qualifying Examination or its successor/equivalent required by HHS and USCIS. Foreign medical graduates must also serve at least two years (rather than one year) of board-approved graduate medical education.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if a foreign medical graduate, provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates that is currently effective and relates to such applicant or provide such credentials as are necessary to certify that such foreign medical graduate has successfully passed the Visa Qualifying Examination or its successor or equivalent examination

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program described in sections 71-2454 to 71-2456.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telehealth is defined as the use of medical information electronically exchanged from one site to another to aid a credential holder in the diagnosis or treatment of a patient, including services originating from a patient's home. Physicians located in another state who perform compensated healing arts services affecting diagnosis or treatment of an individual in Nebraska via electronic medium are deemed to be practicing medicine in Nebraska.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Telehealth means the use of medical information electronically exchanged from one site to another, whether synchronously or asynchronously, to aid a credential holder in the diagnosis or treatment of a patient.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Physician assistant means any person who graduates from an approved program, who has passed a proficiency examination, and who the department, with the recommendation of the board, approves to perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician; the statute does not separately enumerate specific drug schedules but the PA is authorized to perform medical services within the collaborative agreement.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: approves to perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require the applicant to submit to a complete diagnostic examination at the expense of the applicant by one or more physicians or other qualified professionals appointed by the board
